message: Force-push detected. Rewriting shared history has erased teammates' commits before — never force-push a shared branch.
--no-verify bypasses the pre-commit quality gate. Skipping lint/test once shipped a broken build to main.
Recursive rm against data/models/secrets. A stray rm -rf wiped the parquet store once and recovery took a full day.
Hard reset / forced clean discards uncommitted work irreversibly. Stash or branch instead.
Unqualified destructive SQL. A DELETE FROM without a WHERE emptied a table in production.
Use `uv`, not bare `pip`. Mixing pip into this uv-managed project desynced the lockfile and broke CI.
curl | sh executes untrusted remote code. Supply-chain vector — download, inspect, then run.
chmod 777 makes files world-writable. Over-broad permissions exposed a credentials file once.
Direct redirect over a .parquet file bypasses the repository layer and corrupts the stored schema. Write through the repository.
datetime.utcnow() is timezone-naive. Project rule: use datetime.now(UTC). Naive timestamps caused an off-by-hours snapshot bug.
Hard-coded credential / private key detected. Committed secrets have leaked before — load from .env / environment.
Feature pipeline fitted on test/val data = data leakage — the cardinal ML risk here (docs/issues/001). Fit on the training split only.
